title: Settings/power OEM and background-launch promotion

Battery optimization status, settings dry-run, settings round-trip, package identity, declared capabilities, denial copy, Android 15+ background restriction notes, rollback behavior, and OEM notes.

Foreground/background launch behavior matrix for packaged and interactive Node entry points, including Android 15+ restrictions and denial diagnostics.
OEM-specific power-manager notes, settings landing behavior, user-facing prompt copy, task removal behavior, crash recovery, and rollback cleanup.
